exposure: Maternal HIV diagnosis timing (at or after childbirth)
outcome: Rate of new diagnoses of vertically HIV-infected children
cohort: The study included 218 vertically HIV-infected children, aged 0 to 18 years old, who were diagnosed between 2004 and 2013 and were part of the Cohort of the Spanish Pediatric HIV Network (CoRISpe).
finding: The rate of new HIV diagnoses of vertically HIV-infected children significantly decreased in Spain from 0.09 in 2004 to 0.03 per 100,000 inhabitants in 2013.
